overview.text: AIIMS Rishikesh invites two-bid (technical and financial) e-tenders from eligible manufacturers or their authorized distributors/dealers to supply a Paediatric Cystoscope and Resectoscope for its Department of Paediatric Surgery, quantity 01. Reference 24/Paediatric Surgery/ Cystoscope/ 909/ 2026-RISH (ADMN), published 16/10/2026.

summary.issuing_organization: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) Rishikesh-249203; tender issued on behalf of the Executive Director, for Department of Paediatric Surgery; Ref. 24/Paediatric Surgery/ Cystoscope/ 909/ 2026-RISH (ADMN); e-bidding helpdesk 0135-2462915

scope.text: Supply of one Paediatric Cystoscope and Resectoscope for the Department of Paediatric Surgery, AIIMS Rishikesh; quantity 01.
Installation at the consignee's site must be free of cost, immediately on arrival of the equipment.
Supplier is responsible for transport to AIIMS Rishikesh, installation, commissioning demonstration and training if required; these costs are borne by the supplier.
Supply must be in a single consignment with all parts and accessories so the equipment is fully functional at installation; no installation report is signed if any specified part is missing.
Comprehensive warranty for 5 years from satisfactory installation, covering spares, accessories, software and labour.
Note: CMC is not applicable for this item.
Technical specifications of the equipment: Not specified in the document. The page headed 'Technical specifications' has no content.

key_requirements.text: Bids must be submitted online only on the CPPP portal with a valid Digital Signature Certificate; offers by fax/email will not be considered.
All bid pages must be signed and numbered; a signed copy of the terms and conditions must go with the technical bid. Unsigned, incomplete or partial tenders will be rejected.
Must submit a valid CDSCO licence for import, manufacturing and sale of the equipment, plus a copy from the CDSCO Medical Devices Portal.
Authorized agents must submit a manufacturer authorization letter (Annexure-II) stating its purpose and validity period; otherwise the tender is liable to rejection.
Must enclose a covering letter and a compliance sheet against the tender specification, clearly stating any variation.
Sample or demonstration, where required, is at the bidder's expense; non-submission disqualifies the bidder and the financial bid will not be opened.
Equipment must be new and of latest version; date of manufacture must not be more than 3 (Three months) old.
Full description, make/brand, manufacturer name and imported/indigenous status must be stated and original catalogues attached, failing which the tender may be disqualified.
Must submit Annexure-V notarized affidavit, Annexure-VI Integrity Pact, Annexure-VII MII declaration and Annexure-VIII Rule 144 (XI) land-border declaration.
Financial bid must be in the provided BoQ format with the filename unchanged; a modified BoQ file leads to rejection.

eligibility.text: Bidder must be an interested and eligible manufacturer or its authorized distributor/dealer.
Average annual turnover of the last three financial years (FY- 22-23 & 23-24, 24-25) must be not less than Rs. 17,50,000 for the bidder, certified by a Chartered Accountant (Annexure-III).
OEM average turnover for the same period must be not less than Rs. 35,00,000 (Annexure-IV).
Failure to submit the certified turnover statement means the bidder is disqualified at administrative evaluation.

Bidders under Section 44AD/44ADA/44AE of the Income Tax Act must submit a CA turnover certificate with registration number; Indian agents may submit copies of LC purchase orders to cover a turnover shortfall.
Start-ups registered with the Government of India may get turnover relaxation case to case; this is not mandatory.
Must submit two performance certificates from two different customers with purchase orders, showing the OEM supplied these items in the last 03 years.
Must declare not blacklisted or debarred, no criminal case pending, and compliance with Rule 144 (XI) of GFR 2017 land-border restrictions.

important_dates.text: Pre-bid meeting: 23/10/2026 at 4:00 PM, Tender Opening Room, AIIMS Rishikesh; queries must be put in writing on firm letterhead.
Last date of bid submission: 07/11/2026; hard copy of EMD must reach AIIMS Rishikesh by this date/time. Time of day not specified.
Bid validity: 180 (one hundred eighty) days from the published date of opening of the tender.
Local suppliers claiming purchase preference must give an undertaking within 7 days of opening of the financial bid.

commercial_requirements.text: EMD (bid security): Rs. 70,000 in the form of FD/BG; scanned copy with the technical bid and hard copy delivered by last submission date. A bid without EMD will be summarily rejected.
Performance security: 5 % of contract value as FD/BG from a Nationalized/Scheduled bank, pledged to AIIMS Rishikesh, valid three months beyond the contract period; forfeited on late supply or breach.
Price basis: rates must be inclusive of all applicable taxes, packing, forwarding, postage and transportation to AIIMS Rishikesh, stated in figures and words.
Payment: 100 % against the bill on receipt of material in satisfactory condition in central store. No advance for custom clearance/freight/insurance; no demurrage/wharfage payable.
Warranty: must quote 5 years comprehensive warranty from satisfactory installation; warranty charges must not be quoted separately or the offer is summarily rejected.
Liquidated damages for late delivery: 0.5% per week, subject to maximum of 10% of the value of delayed goods; supply may also be cancelled at supplier's cost.
Uptime: equipment must be up for 95% of warranty time; if down more than 5%, up to 20 days 1% or 5,000/- whichever is higher, then each 20-day slab 2% or 10,000/- whichever is higher.

project_duration.text: Delivery period: Not specified in the document; clause 36 says the delivery time stipulated in the supply order is the essence of the contract.
Successful bidder must execute a contract on Rs.100/- stamp paper within twenty-one (21) days from date of award.
Comprehensive warranty period is 5 years from completion of satisfactory installation.
Undertaking to supply spare parts and accessories for the next 10 (Ten) years.
Force majeure notice must be given within two weeks of occurrence.

important_conditions.text: Evaluation: Award normally goes to the agency meeting all conditions with the lowest price in the financial bid; L1 is decided on individual item basis.
Evaluation: L1 is decided on Total Price plus separately quoted CMC charges; price comparison uses basic price and post-warranty CMC.
Evaluation: Purchase preference to local suppliers applies with Margin of Purchase Preference 20%; claimant must be ready to supply at L1 price.

Submission: Checklist documents (S. No. 1-11) such as Annexure-I details, authorization, turnover, affidavit, Integrity Pact, MII, CDSCO licence, performance certificates, EMD and signed terms must go with the technical bid.
Submission: Only one bid per bidder for the same or similar item; otherwise all bids are cancelled and the bidder is disqualified.
Submission: Omission in any column of the financial bid (Schedule of Rates) debars the tender; corrections must be attested and overwriting is not accepted.
Submission: Corrigenda and clarifications are published on the CPPP portal or AIIMS Rishikesh website; bidders must check regularly.
Submission: Pre-bid meeting representatives must bring an authorization letter on firm letterhead and submit queries in writing.
Risk: Technical specifications: page has no content, so specifications are not in the document; a compliance sheet as per specification is still required.
Risk: Warranty conflict: clause 30 says five (5) years guarantee but then refers to period of two years; financial terms and affidavit say 5 years.
Risk: CMC conflict: financial terms require CMC rates (if applicable) with rejection for failure and count them in L1, but the last page says CMC is not applicable.
Risk: EMD conflict: tender states FD/BG, but Integrity Pact lists bank draft or pay order and makes EMD valid up to five years or until warranty concludes.
Risk: Performance security validity differs: bank guarantee form says valid up to 63 months from installation; tender says three months beyond contract period.
Risk: Purchaser may increase or decrease quantity by up to twenty- five (25%) at same unit price; delivery period is not stated in the tender.
